name: metabase
description: Connect to Metabase through its official MCP server.

app.kipster.name: Metabase
app.kipster.addressPrompt: What is your Metabase instance or account MCP address?

research.notes: Metabase serves an MCP on each instance at /api/metabase-mcp once an admin turns it on; the MCP Registry entry io.github.metabase/mcp still lists the older template path /api/mcp. Its embedded OAuth server supports dynamic client registration but not client ID metadata documents or a pre-registered client ID; the docs set no plan limit on the server itself (only MCP analytics need Pro or Enterprise).

probe.reason: An instance or account MCP address is required when connecting
